examples.explanation: If we flip the second card, the face up numbers are [1,3,4,4,7] and the face down are [1,2,4,1,3]. 2 is the minimum good integer as it appears facing down but not facing up. It can be shown that 2 is the minimum possible good integer obtainable after flipping some cards.
There are no good integers no matter how we flip the cards, so we return 0.
